More characters coming as I finish them.

---

## What you need
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI (latest version)[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]Voice Over Framework Mod (VOFM)[/url]

This pack needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]VOFM[/url] to work. I can only voice lines that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]VOFM[/url] already supports.

---

## How to install
1. Download and extract the archive.
2. Drop the `Barbok.VoicePack` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods/` folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. In GMCM or VOFM config, select/enable the packs for Bear, Mr. Qi, Grandpa and/or Birdie.
5. Trigger events:
- Bear (Secret Note #23, 6AM-7PM Secret Woods)
- Grandpa (Year 3 shrine)
- Mr. Qi (Qi quests)
- Birdie (Ginger Island)

**Folder structure:**
Barbok.VoicePack/
├── manifest.json
├── content.json
└── assets/
├── Bear/
├── MrQi/
├── Grandpa/
└── Birdie/

---

## Some things to know
- If a line's missing, it's probably because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]VOFM[/url] doesn't support it yet, not because I didn't record it.
- I'm eventually gonna try to voice everything [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]VOFM[/url] can handle, mainly for practice and my own playthroughs.
- I'm German, so yeah, there's a slight accent even though my English is solid.
- This isn't some big public project – made it for my girlfriend and me, you're welcome to use it.
- Don't ask me to voice modpacks like SVE or anything. Not interested.
- If you find broken/missing vanilla lines for these characters, let me know. Might fix for my own game.

---

## If it's not working
**Voices aren't playing:**
- Check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] is installed/working.
- Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]VOFM[/url] is up to date.
- Folder not nested in `Stardew Valley/Mods/`.
- Events properly triggered? (e.g. Secret Note #23 for Bear).
- Pack selected in config? [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM recommended[/url].
- Check SMAPI log for errors (%appdata%/StardewValley/ErrorLogs/).
